generic_phrases: Water when the top inch or two is dry. Don't let it sit in water.
Give it full sun, or at least 6 hours of bright light.
check the roots for rot. Mushy brown roots mean overwatering. Firm white roots mean the plant is fine.
Repot only if the roots are circling or poking out of the drainage holes
